Hon'ble Shri Ramesh Sinha, Chief Justice Hon'ble Shri Ravindra Kumar Agrawal, Judge Order on Board Per Ramesh Sinha, Chief Justice 01-04-2026 1.
Heard Mr. Akhand Pratap, learned counsel for the petitioners.

Also heard Mr. S. S. Baghel,
learned Govt. Advocate, appearing for State- Respondent No.1, Mr. Sudhanshu Upadhyay, learned counsel for the Respondent No.2.
2.

The present petition has been filed by the petitioners seeking the following relief(s):
"1. Quash and set aside Charge-Sheet bearing No. 223 of 2023, submitted by Police Station Azad Chowk, District Raipur in FIR No. 199 of 2022 registered under Sections 120B & 420 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, and all consequential proceedings arising therefrom on the ground of compromise.
2. Quash and set aside the order dated 22.12.2023 passed by the learned Judicial Magistrate First Class Raipur, whereby cognizance was taken against the petitioners for the offences under Sections 120B & 420 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
3. Quash and set aside the order dated 11.02.2026 passed in criminal case No. 22589 of 2023, passed by the learned learned Judicial Magistrate First Class Raipur Raipur District Raipur whereby charges under Sections 120B & 420 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 have been framed against the petitioners.
4. Quash the entire proceedings of Criminal Case No. 22589 of 2023, for the offence punishable under Sections 120B & 420 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 pending before learned Judicial Magistrate First Class Raipur Raipur, District Raipur, as continuation of the said trial

sentences.text: On a pointed query being made from the counsel for the petitioners as to why he has filed such documents and as to where the original documents are, he states that the same are with the petitioners.

Learned counsel for the petitioners states that he would file the original copies of the compromise/settlement agreement dated 02-12-2025 and prays that the present petition may be dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to file it afresh.

4. Accordingly, the present petition is dismissed as withdrawn with the aforesaid liberty subject to depositing a sum of Rs.5,000/- by each of the petitioners (total Rs. 30,000/-) as cost in the Registry of this Court and respondent No.2 shall also deposit Rs.10,000/- as cost in the Registry of this Court for filing the petition in a most casual manner without annexing the original copy of the compromise/settlement agreement dated 02-12-2025, and wasting the precious time of this Court.

The said total amount of Rs.40,000/- shall be transmitted to Government Home for Mentally Underdeveloped Children, Mana Camp, District Raipur (C.G.).
5.
Certified copy, if any, filed in the petition be returned back to the learned counsel for the petitioners after retaining its attested true copy.

Sd/- Sd/-
 (Ravindra Kumar Agrawal) (Ramesh Sinha)
